projects.title: Automated Portfolio Generator via AI Agent Pipeline
projects.summary: A self-hosted pipeline that clones repositories, extracts commit hotspots, and uses AI agents to generate structured case-study cards for a static portfolio site. The system runs entirely through CLI tools and markdown-based agent prompts, producing a single projects.json source file.
projects.problem_solved: The initial fetcher and analyzer agents relied on GitHub MCP, which introduced unnecessary complexity and unstable connections during repo scanning.
projects.how_i_solved_it: I replaced the MCP dependency with direct gh CLI invocations and rewrote the analyzer prompts to enforce strict JSON schemas and skip failed repos gracefully.
